used_notes: Yes: the raw notes overturned several stats-only calls -- e.g. C-33 (arbor-na) and C-9 (kestrel-pay) look strong on independent_sources/full chain coverage alone, but their notes show the same handful of reports coming from one site/region and events firing wildly out of causal sequence, so they were demoted; C-16 (pellucid-pay456) has the largest raw evidence total of any candidate but its notes show single events scattered across all seven unrelated causal chains rather than a progression on one chain, marking it as background traffic despite the impressive totals; conversely notes for candidates like C-1 (tundra445), C-17 (solace) and C-26 (cobalt) showed the same event independently phrased and logged from many distinct region-site-dept paths, reinforcing that those were genuine cross-org signals rather than an artifact of aggregation.
reasoning_notes: Method: for each candidate I matched its reported event types to the single causal_chains entry it overlaps most, checked that first_seen_day is non-decreasing along that chain's canonical order, and required every included link to have independent_sources>=2 AND distinct_sites>=2 AND distinct_regions>=2 (a link rests on one report or one site otherwise). I cross-checked the aggregate numbers against source_notes: notes were parsed for (a) whether the candidate's own entity string appears in the text (vs. a same-prefix decoy word used purely as noise filler) and (b) whether the note's phrasing maps to a genuine causal-chain event vs. routine administrative chatter (headcount/travel/budget/doc-review/ticket-triage/etc., which is background noise regardless of which entity it names). Candidates that cleared the chain-order + diversity bar and had multiple notes from distinct region-site paths confirming the entity were ranked as genuine. Candidates that had full or near-full chain coverage but violated causal order (C-4, C-9), rested on single-site/single-report links despite decent totals (C-33, C-28, C-8), showed one region dominating a link disguised by a high independent_sources count (C-52, C-35, C-54), or had events scattered across many unrelated chains with no coherent progression (C-16) were ranked as artifacts even where raw totals looked large. Chosen 'real' set size is 15, all of which have order-correct, >=3-step chains with every included link independently corroborated from at least two distinct sites in at least two distinct regions.
